# VoC Radar

VoC Radar groups public App Store reviews into recurring issues and links each issue to evidence reviews. Published reports are readable without login. New analysis and refresh requests require a user account.

Canonical site: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/

## When to use VoC Radar

Use VoC Radar when you need to:

- inspect recurring bugs, account or payment problems, policy complaints, and usability requests in public App Store reviews;
- compare an issue summary with the public reviews that support it;
- check the review window and last published analysis time before using a result in product, CX, QA, or operations work; or
- retrieve an already published report through a read-only JSON API.

Do not treat one report as a complete measure of app quality or all user sentiment. The service analyzes public App Store reviews only, and automated grouping can be imperfect. Confirm important conclusions against the evidence reviews.

## Public web routes

- App discovery: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/
- Report overview: `https://voc-radar.satinode.com/apps/{country}/{appId}/overview`
- Issue list: `https://voc-radar.satinode.com/apps/{country}/{appId}/issues`
- Public reviews: `https://voc-radar.satinode.com/apps/{country}/{appId}/reviews`
- Privacy policy: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/privacy

`country` is a two-letter App Store country code such as `kr`. `appId` is the numeric App Store ID.

## Public API

- OpenAPI: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/openapi.json
- Health: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/api/health
- Discover apps: `GET /api/public/discover`
- Published report: `GET /api/public/report`
- Issues and evidence: `GET /api/public/issues` and `GET /api/public/issues/{issueId}`
- Public reviews: `GET /api/public/reviews`

The OpenAPI document is the source for query parameters and response shapes. Public API responses are JSON except the artwork endpoint. Error responses contain a stable error code, a safe message, retryability, and a request ID when available.

`/api/private/*` requires a user session. `/api/internal/*` belongs to the analysis pipeline. Agents must not probe, call, or attempt to bypass those protected surfaces.

## Discovery

- Sitemap: https://voc-radar.satinode.com/sitemap.xml
- Source repository: https://github.com/jeonsavvy/VoC-Radar
